reason: H0 does not exercise the S1 lifecycle in which TidyPPrintTabs is configured, TY_(AdjustConfig) establishes doc->indent_char, and a subsequent save consumes that state. The save-capable harnesses never enable TidyPPrintTabs, while tidy_config_fuzzer loads configuration but releases the document without parsing or saving it.
evidence: S1 moves the TidyPPrintTabs-dependent assignment of doc->indent_char from tidyDocSaveStream into TY_(AdjustConfig).
tidy_general_fuzzer's bool_options includes TidyKeepTabs but not TidyPPrintTabs, and it does not call tidySaveBuffer.
tidy_fuzzer, tidy_parse_string_fuzzer, and tidy_xml_fuzzer call tidySaveBuffer but never set TidyPPrintTabs.
tidy_config_fuzzer calls tidyLoadConfig and then immediately tidyRelease, so configured indentation state is not exercised through document serialization.
recommended_action: Add a target that fuzzes TidyPPrintTabs and related indentation settings, then runs the full create/configure/parse/clean/diagnose/save protocol. Include both boolean values and configuration changes before saving so TY_(AdjustConfig), doc->indent_char, and tidyDocSaveStream are exercised together.
